《Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars》is Apple TV's documentary series about chasing the highest honour in the culinary world, and it's now back. Here are the details.

《Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars》回歸

Less than a year after Season 1 first aired, the show has already returned with a brand-new eight-episode season, telling the story of restaurants around the world as they vie for, retain or add to their Michelin stars.

Hosted by food and travel expert Jesse Burgess, with Gordon Ramsay and Studio Ramsay Global serving as executive producers, the series documents the restaurants, chefs and their teams, and the relentless effort behind winning and keeping this most prestigious accolade in the culinary world.

Announced by Apple just days ago, the new season will feature 16 restaurants across Europe, the United States and Brazil, each at a different stage in their pursuit of stars.

Following today's premiere of the first two episodes, new instalments will be released every Friday until 6 November.
